items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: I don't remember her at all.

ctx.x: Is there anything about Sammy Price and Bunk? I know they worked together. I can't recall anything offhand. Except of course where you know that Sammy's mother must have been Bunk's girl back in Texas there too. Yeah, yeah. He went out with her up there too, you say.

Yeah, they seemed to be old friends, that's right. Was she working at... She was working at Ryan's at the time. I don't remember her at all. Well, she was a very fine blues singer and she wasn't working entertaining at Ryan's. No, I know. A restroom attendant or something? Yeah, something like that.
